title: Carousel | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Panoramic Views & Private Pool | Sleeps 26 | Event Friendly- Carousel
description_expanded: Description: Carousel by Royal Destinations Location: Blue Mountain Beach Address: 230 Blue Lake Road, Santa Rosa Beach, FL Details: Experience the height of opulence at Carousel, one of the most stunning Blue Mountain vacation rentals along Florida’s iconic 30A. This exquisite estate offers breathtaking Gulf views and sits within steps of beach access in the highly desirable Blue Mountain Beach community. Featuring a large private pool, expansive backyard oasis, and private gym, Carousel embodies everything guests look for in 30A vacation rentals with a private pool and modern luxury. This remarkable, newer 30A luxury vacation rental has been meticulously designed without sparing a single detail, ensuring the most captivating coastal escape imaginable. The interior showcases state-of-the-art amenities and designer finishes, while the exterior maximizes sweeping Gulf views and provides the exclusivity and privacy discerning travelers expect from 30A luxury rentals. Nestled on an oversized double corner lot, Carousel is just one home away from direct beach access and within half a mile of top dining, shopping, and entertainment. A custom elevator adorned with hand-painted murals provides access to all four floors, making it easy for everyone to enjoy every inch of this exceptional home. Each of the seven bedrooms includes its own en-suite bathroom, and the home’s thoughtful layout allows beach views from nearly every room. With parking for up to six vehicles and exceptional space for gatherings, Carousel is the ideal getaway for extended families, retreats, or milestone celebrations. For travelers seeking vacation rentals on 30A that blend sophistication, comfort, and proximity to the beach, Carousel stands above the rest. Don’t miss your chance to experience this unparalleled retreat—book Carousel today and discover why it’s one of the most extraordinary luxury 30A rentals available. Home Highlights: - Distance To Beach Access: 300 Feet (Or 1-Minute Walk) From Seagrade Road Public Beach Access - *Large Heated Private Pool with Tanning Ledge and Jetted Spa - Workout Room/Gym with Gulf Views (by request) - 4th Floor Game Room with Gulf Views, Billiards Table, and JumboTron - Multiple Balconies with Gulf Views Including A Spacious 4th Floor Balcony with Multiple Seating Areas - Elevator - 8 Adult Bikes - Industrial Ice Machine - Double Appliances in Kitchen - Two Laundry Rooms *Please Note: Pool heat is available for an additional $350 (pre-tax). The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 26 7 Bedrooms / 7 Full Baths / 3 Half Baths First Floor: - Living Room, Dining Room, Double Kitchen Including Two Stoves, Two Sinks, Two Dishwashers, Two Beverage Fridges, Half Bath - Private Backyard with Infinity Swimming Pool\Jetted Spa and Grilling Station. Second Floor: - Bedroom 1: King Suite with En-Suite Bathroom (sleeps 2) - Bedroom 2: King Suite with En-Suite Bathroom (sleeps 2) - Bedroom 3: King Suite with En-Suite Bathroom (sleeps 2) - Second Floor Living Room with Pullout Bed (sleeps 2) - Half Bath - Laundry Room - Gulf Views and Pool View Covered Balconies Third Floor: - Bedroom 4 King Suite with En-Suite Bathroom and 2 Loft Twins (sleeps 4) - Bedroom 5: King Suite with En-Suite Bathroom (sleeps 2) - Bedroom 6: Two Queen Suite with En-Suite Bathroom and Bunk Twin/Twin (sleeps 6) - Bedroom 7: Bunk Room with Two Sets of Twin/Twin Bunks, En-Suite Bathroom (sleeps 4) - Custom Beach View Gym (Access by request) - Gulf View Balconies - Laundry Room 2 Fourth Floor - Game Room with Billiards Table and JumboTron - Fourth Floor Living Room - Wet Bar with Beverage Fridge - Spacious Panoramic Beach View Balcony - Half Bath Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
